issues.body: Section 10.4 hard-codes individual run durations, a selected-leg count, and a projected '+4–10 m' median-wall effect; section 10.5 adds more fixed timing values. These are dated profile observations/projections embedded as durable evidence. The repository's reviewer contract explicitly disallows hard-coded performance numbers and says session/work-box/EC2 timings are non-canonical. The same projected range is also repeated in the companion changed research record.
issues.fix_hint: Remove the literal durations, leg-count range, and projected minute range from the prose/table. Link to the profile or generated benchmark artifact and describe the conclusion qualitatively (for example, that forcing the full matrix restores the materially slower full-matrix shape). Make the corresponding removal in research/ci-mergequeue-speedup-2026-07.md.
issues.title: New hard-coded performance numbers violate the repository evidence policy

verdict.summary: The batch-stacking argument is internally coherent and explicitly records its remote ALLGREEN premise, but the change cannot be approved because it adds concrete, non-canonical timing figures and a projected performance range to a research record. Repository review policy expressly forbids hard-coded performance numbers and requires work-box/dated profile timings not to be presented as canonical evidence. Replace the figures with links to the generated/profile evidence and a qualitative cost statement, or use the repository's approved generated benchmark-data mechanism.
